fusions.name: Catch and Hurl
fusions.desc: Your tongue grips one enemy up to 6 tiles away and throws it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Chest-Drum Boom
fusions.desc: A croak drummed out of your inflated throat deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves them [Weakened] for 8 seconds. A boss or elite also loses 6% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Knuckled Crouch
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Thick in the Haunch

riders.text: and your fists are back before they are missed
and you are already somewhere else

fusions.desc: Raises your Power by 1, and your Power ceiling by 1. From bronze rank you move 5% faster, from silver you attack 5% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises 5%.
